text_block_list.text:
Today is the Spring Fan Fest and the
academy is
bustling with both students
and fans.
Hey, Trainer! Have you seen Голд Шип?!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Tch! Where the heck did she go?!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Bakushin, Bakushiiin!
text_block_list.name: Сакура Бакушин-О

text_block_list.text: Damn! Bakushin O is also on the loose!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Geez. We've got to do something before
this
devolves into pure chaos. Should we
deal with
Голд Шип first, or—
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Outta the way! I'm running here! The
main street
belongs to meeee!
text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо

text_block_list.text: Gaaah!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Everyone's just doing whatever they
want! Think
about the people who have
to clean up after you!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: ...I should have never agreed to patrol.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
This is all the Empress's fault, always
nagging
everyone and telling people to
work harder.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
This is a total handful. There's no way I
can
handle the plaza alone.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан
choice_data_list: Then, why not get some help?

text_block_list.text: Huh?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: All right! Now, everyone get out there!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Right! Let's go!
text_block_list.name: Miho Dormitory Students

text_block_list.text:
I'll deal with Turbo. I've received a lot of
help
from the student council, after all.
text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus

text_block_list.text:
Give me somethin' to do, Brian! I'll show
ya what
I'm made of!
text_block_list.name: Водка

text_block_list.text:
When I mentioned that Нарита Брайан
needed some
help, there was no
shortage of volunteers.
choice_data_list: They all want to help you, Brian.

text_block_list.text:
Heh... It's not me they want to help.
They just
want to help the student
council.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Brian! What should I do?!
text_block_list.name: Водка

text_block_list.text: Do whatever you want.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Whaaat?! C'mon, this is my big chance
to work
with y—
text_block_list.name: Водка

text_block_list.text:
Gyaaaaah! Ghost! There's a ghost
wearing a
burlap sack!
text_block_list.name: Street Vendor Umamusume

text_block_list.text: Tch, sounds like Голд Шип! I'm going.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Um...
text_block_list.name: Водка

text_block_list.text:
You come too! Stopping Голд Шипп is no
walk in
the park!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: R-right!
text_block_list.name: Водка

text_block_list.text: Hold it right there, Голд Шип!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Whoaaa, mitts off, Brian! This is my bag!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Tch! ...Well, I won't give you the time to
enjoy it!
Водка, 3 o'clock!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Gotcha!
text_block_list.name: Водка

text_block_list.text: Darrrn yooou! I'll remember this!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: Hell yeah! Sayin' stuff like "3 o'clock!" is just way too cool!
text_block_list.name: Водка

text_block_list.text: Hm. Thanks for the help, Водка.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Um... Brian?
text_block_list.name: Водка

text_block_list.text:
Could ya say that again? Say it just one
more
time, please!
text_block_list.name: Водка

text_block_list.text: Gotcha!
text_block_list.name: Водка

text_block_list.text: All right! What's next, Vice Prez?
text_block_list.name: Водка

text_block_list.text: Sigh... Calm down. Enjoy the fact that nothing's happening.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, it seems everyone's taken quite a
liking to
you, Brian.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: ...President.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
A little bird told me you've recruited
some
students to assist with your duties.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Seeing you like this makes me proud. I'd
love to
see you leading the student
council one day.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Pass.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Haha, maybe one day.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
After that, Нарита Брайан continues her
work with
the help of the other students.

I get to see how much everyone adores
Narita
Brian as the student council
vice-president.
